individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge); it is not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so the error-bar check does not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts show group means with error bars (n=20) but no overlaid individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars appear on both bar charts with significance annotations (n=20, *p<0.05, **p<0.01) but the caption never states what the error bars represent (e.g. SD or SEM).

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel C is a blot, not a plot, so the error-bar check does not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N indicated in bars) but no individual data points are overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are shown on the SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts (with ## p<0.01 annotations) but the caption does not specify what the error bars represent.

individual-data-points.explanation: The FACS histograms plot the full distribution of TMRM intensity across all individual cells (counts vs intensity), so they already display the underlying data rather than a summary statistic requiring overlaid points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The FACS histograms show raw per-replicate distributions without error bars, so no definition is needed.
